annotation.title_clean: Δημοσίευση του ν. 4784/2021 (Α' 40) «Η Ελλάδα σε κίνηση: Βιώσιμη Αστική Κινητικότητα-Μικροκινητικότητα-Ρυθμίσεις για τον εκσυγχρονισμό, την απλούστευση και την ψηφιοποίηση διαδικασιών του Υπουργείου Υποδομών και Μεταφορών και άλλες διατάξεις»
annotation.title_en: Publication of Law 4784/2021 "Greece in Motion: Sustainable Urban Mobility – Micromobility – Provisions for modernisation, simplification and digitalisation of Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport procedures and other provisions"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Hellenic Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport, General Secretariat of Transport
annotation.venue: Diavgeia (Hellenic Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport circular)
annotation.summary_en: Greek Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport circular informing authorities of Law 4784/2021, covering micromobility vehicles (e-scooters), traffic rules, professional driver competence certificates, and driving licences. It notes in passing that Article 42 amends the Road Traffic Code on the circulation of automated vehicles.
key_provisions_or_claims: E-scooters (EPHO) limited to 25 km/h and barred from roads with limits above 50 km/h
Minimum rider ages 12 and 15, mandatory helmets and ID, fixed administrative fines
Article 42 amends Article 13 of the Road Traffic Code on automated vehicle circulation
Transposes Directive 2018/645 on professional driver qualification
Provisions in force from 16 March 2021, with exceptions for Articles 26-28 and 37
